detailed_description: The Timezone Converter converts a selected date and time from one IANA time zone to another using browser Intl time zone support. Choose a source time zone, target time zone, date, and time, then review the converted date, time, and full formatted result. The page also includes quick world clock references for common cities. It is useful for meeting planning and scheduling checks, while calendar invites should still be verified in your calendar app around daylight-saving transitions.
usage_steps: Enter the date and time to convert.
Click Convert or use the current time shortcut.
Copy the formatted result or swap zones for the reverse conversion.
usage_examples: Convert Shanghai meeting time to New York time.
Check London time for a Tokyo event.
Plan a remote handoff across two time zones.
Use the world clock list for quick current-time context.

faqs.question: Does it handle daylight saving time?
faqs.answer: It uses browser Intl time zone data, which accounts for known time zone rules available in the runtime.

faqs.question: Which time zones are available?
faqs.answer: The page uses supported IANA time zones from the browser when available, with a fallback list for common zones.

faqs.question: Can I convert the current time?
faqs.answer: Yes. The page includes a shortcut to use the current date and time.

faqs.question: Should I verify calendar invites?
faqs.answer: Yes. For important meetings, confirm the time in your calendar app, especially near daylight-saving changes.

faqs.question: Can I copy the result?
faqs.answer: Yes. The converted full result can be copied from the page.
